# Greatist

> > Greatist is a health and wellness publication covering fitness, nutrition, mental health, and lifestyle topics with medically-reviewed content and expert guidance.

Greatist provides evidence-based health content organized into three main pillars: Move (fitness and exercise), Eat (nutrition and recipes), and Live (lifestyle and wellness). The site features beginner-friendly guides, workout tutorials, healthy recipes, and articles addressing physical health, sexual health, mental wellness, and chronic conditions.

## Key Topics

- HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
- Mental Health
- Fitness & Exercise
- Nutrition & Recipes
- Sexual Health
- Strength Training
- Health Conditions (ADHD, IBD, Psoriatic Arthritis, Alopecia)
- Kettlebell Training
- Beginner Fitness Guides
- Yoga & Wellness
- Home Workouts
- Bodyweight Exercises
- Hair Loss & Skin Care
- Cooking Techniques
- Health & Wellness

## Main Navigation

- [Greatist: Homepage](https://greatist.com): Main homepage for health, fitness, nutrition, and wellness content
- [ABOUT US](https://greatist.com/about/about-us): Company overview, editorial standards, and medical review process
- [Move: Fitness Hub](https://greatist.com/move): Fitness section hub featuring workouts, rucking, and exercise guides
- [Eat: Nutrition Hub](https://greatist.com/eat): Nutrition and recipes section hub for food and cooking content
- [Live: Lifestyle Hub](https://greatist.com/live): Live/lifestyle section hub covering wellness and daily health topics
- [Greatist Fitness](https://greatist.com/fitness): Fitness category page with morning workouts, HIIT, and kettlebell content
- [Greatist Nutrition](https://greatist.com/nutrition): Nutrition category covering meal prep, diets, and supplement guides
- [Yoga](https://greatist.com/fitness/yoga): Yoga section hub covering poses, styles, and wellness integration

## Fitness & Exercise Guides

- [How to Make a Strength Training Plan: Tips and Sample Workouts](https://greatist.com/fitness/how-make-strength-training-plan-and-keep-it): Beginner's guide to building strength training routines with Ideen Chelengar
- [How to Plank: Perfect Your Form and Avoid Common Mistakes](https://greatist.com/fitness/perfect-plank): Core strengthening plank tutorial with form tips and variations
- [Master KB Swings: Tips for Perfect Form and Avoiding Mistakes](https://greatist.com/move/how-to-do-the-perfect-kettlebell-swing): Russian kettlebell swing form guide with common mistake corrections
- [How to Box: 6 Basic Moves for Beginners to Master Boxing](https://greatist.com/fitness/boxing-workout-basic-moves-for-beginners): Beginner boxing guide with 6 fundamental moves from Tatiana Firpo
- [Top Arm Workouts at Home: No Weights Needed](https://greatist.com/fitness/exercises-at-home-for-arms): Bodyweight arm exercises at home with trainer Thomas Salvatore tips

## Health & Wellness

- [How to Build a Skin Care Routine: Tips and Product Suggestions](https://greatist.com/health/skincare-routine): Personalized skincare routine builder by skin type with product tips
- [How to Treat Eczema Fast at Home: 13 Natural Remedies](https://greatist.com/eczema/natural-remedies-eczema): 13 natural at-home eczema treatments for flare-up management
- [Here are the Common Reasons Why Your Hair is Falling Out in Clumps?](https://greatist.com/live/hair-falling-out-in-clumps): Hair loss causes including stress, alopecia, and treatment options
- [Can Vitamins Help with Hair Loss? Your FAQ](https://greatist.com/health/alopecia-areata-vitamins-faq): Vitamin D, zinc, iron, and B12 for alopecia areata hair growth
- [Why Does My Head Hurt Everyday? Causes and Solutions Explained](https://greatist.com/health/constant-headache): Chronic daily headache causes, types, and treatment options explained
- [How to Stop Breakthrough Bleeding on the Pill Immediately](https://greatist.com/health/breakthrough-bleeding-on-pill): Managing breakthrough bleeding from oral contraceptives and when to seek help
